notes: Pictures: Insert → Picture… (Ctrl+Shift+P) puts a photo, scan, logo, signature or a page of a PDF on the page; right-click the page for Insert Picture Here
Drag a picture's corners to scale it (Shift: freely), its sides to stretch it, Ctrl + a side to skew it, the round handle to turn it
The picture bar: opacity, crop (or double-click the picture), skew, flip, turn, grey or black and white, remove white background, brightness and contrast, border, exact size, reset, make part of page
Pictures added on the phone open here ready to edit, and the other way round; they look the same in any PDF viewer
Checks for a new version once a day and asks before updating (Help → Check for Updates Daily turns it off)
From 1.6.4: the side panel folds into a slim strip of icons (the button at the end of its tabs, or F4), and stays the way you left it
Fixed: the round turn handle of a selected drawing could leave a trace on the page after a resize
